title: Zwischenbericht Quellen Into Bibliography
description: Remove the explicit Quellen tables from the mit-bestand Zwischenbericht (P.Q in anhang/projekte.tex and SB.Q in anhang/sekundaerbefunde.tex) and replace them with a proper biblatex bibliography: new references.bib, \cite in each project's Allgemein table and in the SB appendix intro, \SemioReferences rendered in the V Verzeichnisse appendix chapter. Also extend the shared semio-window.sty reference row to show the source URL and fix a suspected \citefield argument-order bug, verified against a rebuilt zukunftbau template.
summary:
Fixed Puzzle 3D introduction step 3 (Move Objects) not highlighting the folded Tools rail. Root cause: the shell was force-unfolding the toolbar for utility-anchored steps, which removed the unfold toggle from the DOM while the Move button was still hidden inside nested utility groups — so no anchor resolved and no pulse appeared.

Changes:
- UIIntroduction now accepts anchorFallbackSelectors and prefers the primary anchor, falling back to folded-chrome toggles (Tools/Actions unfold chips) with an automatic highlight pulse.
- Added introductionWindowToolbarUnfoldSelector / introductionWindowActionPaneUnfoldSelector helpers.
- os-shell passes the correct fallback for utility/action introduction steps and stops force-unfolding the toolbar.
- Puzzle 3D move-utility step now uses IntroductionEmphasis::Highlight.
- Added vitest coverage for fallback selector mapping and pulsing unfold-chip behavior.
